panel: Panel A. Variable definitions
rows: One-day implied volatility. Square root of the annualized one-day implied variance in equation (1), times 100. The implied variance uses at-the-money trades between 08:00 and 09:00 UTC in the option series that expires at 08:00 UTC the next day.

Realized volatility. Square root of the annualized realized variance in equation (2), times 100. The realized variance is the sum of squared five-minute log returns of the perpetual futures price from 09:00 UTC to 08:00 UTC the next day.
Variance premium in volatility points. IV minus RV.
